en: Colorized historic postcard showing a large multi-storey stone building with red-tiled roofs on a cobblestone street. Horse-drawn carriages and a few pedestrians stand in front of the structure. The architecture is late 19th–early 20th century European. Text in Russian and German at the top identifies the city as Mitau and indicates that the building houses the city savings bank and police administration.
